        The bug was caused by the incorrect placement of the `ti,no-idle-on-init` and `ti,no-reset-on-init` flags, which were defined at the GPIO0 node level instead of the interconnect target module level. This misplacement led to warnings indicating that the flags should be at the module level, as they are intended to control the behavior of the interconnect target module rather than the GPIO node itself.
